Browse camera-free themes & new concepts →

Start with 37 designs that need no camera, app or subscription. Ten camera prototypes remain available separately. Print packs contain native X1C plates, individual STL parts, assembly notes and parametric source. Editable STEP is a separate download. Open a design to compare its actual plate count, color loads and unsliced print-time estimate.

The camera collection uses ASA and a specified camera for each design. Wyze Battery Cam Pro builds need its official close-up lens; Birdfy builds leave room for the antenna. Cameras, mounting hardware and the reused bottle are not printed. Read each build’s service and mounting instructions.
